partner_result_applied.application: used the partner's independent q-dependent sharp-Hausdorff--Young audit at the actual inequality alpha_i<=A(h,beta), with q*=max(1,2A)

new_result_summary: For any original-coordinate cross block M and any row projection P, let T2=sum_{j>=3}s_j^2, h=max diag P, beta=sqrt(3)||P_perp M||op/sqrt(T2), and A=max_{u<=h}(sqrt(u)+beta sqrt(1-u))^2. If A<3/4, q*=max(1,2A) gives a genuine unweighted L1 Fourier bound 2pi*[3e/((3-2q*)sqrt(q*))]*[s1^2 s2^2 T2]^(-1/6). For top-two singular projections and tail stable rank >407.64675, failure forces >2/3 leverage on both sides and hence at most two physical hub candidates per side.
